preferences.career_goal: Industry employment in health technology (examples: Garmin and WHOOP) or biotechnology.
preferences.website_audience: Industry hiring teams in health technology and biotechnology, with emphasis on collaborative research and project or product work.
preferences.preferred_work: Working with people, collaborating, generating ideas, research, and project management. Interested in data science but prefers work that is not deeply technical or coding-heavy.
preferences.working_style: Strong preference for in-person collaboration: getting on a whiteboard with a few coworkers, drawing schematics and plans, annotating them, and repeatedly revising the plan together.
preferences.positioning_constraint: Technical background should support scientific judgment and collaboration; do not position primarily as a software engineer or imply unverified product/project leadership experience.
preferences.logo_character: Preserve the light, open feel of original Open #3. User disliked both refinements.

preferences.logo_tucked_refinement: Match the shapes of the two upper curves; align their right-hand tips vertically, with the s curve directly beneath the r curve.
preferences.next_design_step: Apply the approved design system to the actual website. Featured project wording and presentation remain provisional.

preferences.copy_tone: Prefer straightforward section headings over slogan-like phrases. Avoid em dashes in the introduction.
